BY EXECUTIVE ENGINEER
(1) (2) (3) (4)
MMISF ACT, 2005.
NOTIFICATION-III
No. 266-IB-Notification-3-BP-2024.—
Whereas, it has been decided to delineate the Area of
Operation of Water User Association (WUAs) on
hydraulic basis and as per Administrative convenience
Itiyadoh Irrigation Division, Gondia hereby, delineate
Areas of Operation of following WUAs and direct that the
-------------
certified copy of the updated map and list of land holders
and/or occupiers of said WUAs shall be displayed on the
-------------
notice board of the officers, of concerned Gram
Therefore, I, Rajiv Gosai Kurekar, Executive Engineer,
declare that no water shall be supplied by the
Appropriate Authority to an individual holder or occupiers
of such land and that system of supply of water through
-------------
Water User Association shall be binding on all the
BEÚòhÉ . . 177 12 holders and occupiers of the land under Management of
------------- Irrigation System by Farmers ;
Any person affected by this notification or part
-------------
thereof, may, within thirty days from the date of
publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, file
Irrigation Circle, Bhandara.

185 0 26
Whereas, it has been decided to delineate Area
-------------
of Operation of Water Users Association (WUA’s) on
hydraulic basis and as per Administrative convenience
-------------
under Sections 5, 6, 7 and Rule 3 of the MMISF Act, 2005.
I, Rajiv Gosai Kurekar, the Executive Engineer, Bagh
-------------
Itiyadoh Irrigation Division, Gondia hereby, delineate Area
of Operation of following WUA’s and direct that the
certified copy of the updated map and list of land holders
and/or occupiers of said WUAs shall be displayed on the
(1) (2) (3) (4)
notice board of the offices of concerned Gram Panchayat,
Tahsil Offices, Irrigation Section, Sub-Division and Division
& at other prominent public places.
Therefore, I, Rajiv Gosai Kurekar, the Executive Engi-
neer, Bagh Itiyadoh Irrigation Division, Gondia also hereby,
declare that no water shall be supplied by the Appropriate
Authority to an individual holder or occupier of such land
and that system of supply of water through Water Users
Association shall be binding on all the holders and occu-
-------------
piers of the land under Management of Irrigation System
by Farmers.
-------------

Any person affected by this notification or part thereof, SCHEDULE—Contd.E
may within thirty days from the date of publication
(1) (2) (3)
of this notification in the Official Gazette, file an appeal
H. A.
before Superintending Engineer, Bhandara Irrigation
Circle, Bhandara.

No. 266-IB-Notification-3-BP-2024.— 499/1 0 81
499/2 0 40
Whereas, it has been decided to delineate Area of
Operation of Water Users Association (WUAs) on 499/3 0 53
hydraulic basis and as per administrative convenience 501 0 74
under Sections 5, 6, 7 and Rule 3 of the MMISF Act, 502 0 23
2005, I, Rajiv Gosai Kurekar, Executive Engineer, Bagh
503 0 10
Itiyadoh Irrigation Division, Gondia hereby, delineate Area
504 0 04
of Operation of following WUAs and direct that the
505 0 84
certified copy of the updated map and list of land holders
and/or occupiers of said WUAs shall be displayed on 592 0 20
the notice board of the offices of concerned Gram 593 0 59
Panchayat, Tahsil Offices, Irrigation Section, Sub-Division 594 0 34
and Division and at other prominent public places;
595 0 36
Therefore I, Rajiv Gosai Kurekar, Executive Engineer, 596 0 21
Bagh Itiyadoh Irrigation Division, Gondia also hereby
597 0 46
declare that no water shall be supplied by the
598/1 0 31
Appropriate Authority to an individual holder or occupier
598/2 0 20
of such land and that system of supply of water through
606 0 22 Water Users Association shall be binding on all the
holders and occupiers of the land under Management of 609 0 14
Irrigation System by Farmers. 610/1 0 26
610/2 0 52 Any person affected by this notification or part
thereof, may within thirty days from the date of 610/3 0 20
publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, file 610/4 0 36
an appeal before Superintending Engineer, Bhandara
610/5 0 20
Irrigation Circle, Bhandara.
